setup.step.installIphone: Get the {app} app from the App Store.
setup.step.installAndroid: Get the {app} app from Google Play.
setup.step.signIn: Sign in to the branch network
setup.step.signInText: Use the account the branch admin gave you. If the app says the device needs approval, ask the admin to approve it.
setup.step.turnOnIphone: In the Tailscale app, switch it on until it shows {connected}. It works on any Wi-Fi or mobile data.
setup.step.turnOnAndroid: Switch it on and allow the VPN connection Android asks about, until it shows {connected}.
setup.step.checkText: Return to this page and tap Check my phone.
setup.title: Set up this phone
setup.lead: Do this once per phone. Afterwards the phone opens the console securely and its camera can scan parcel barcodes.
setup.notSetUp: Not set up yet. Check that Tailscale shows Connected on this phone and that the admin approved it. The office computer must be on.
setup.noAddress: No secure address yet. The office needs to share the app with Tailscale Serve (Settings › Ready for phones? shows what is missing).
setup.stuck: Stuck? Ask the branch admin. Typing tracking codes works without this setup.
setup.readyText: Connected through the branch Tailscale network. The camera can now scan parcel barcodes. Allow the camera when the browser asks.
setup.tip: Tip: once it opens, add it to the Home Screen. iPhone: Share › Add to Home Screen. Android: the ⋮ menu › Add to Home screen.

secure.title: Camera scanning needs the branch's secure address
secure.body: Phone browsers only allow the camera on {https} pages, so it stays off here. Typing the tracking code still works.
secure.setup: First time? Set up this phone
sounds.title: Sounds on this device
sounds.lead: While the Notifications page is open: a soft chime when a run finishes, three rounds of short beeps when it needs someone. Each lasts about 3 seconds. Saved in this browser only.
phoneCard.title: Set up a staff phone
phoneCard.lead: Phones reach the console through this branch's Tailscale network, with a normal trusted certificate. Nothing to install apart from the Tailscale app.
phoneCard.noAddress: No phone address yet: the setup code appears here once Tailscale Serve shares the app (or BRANCH_URL is set). Fix the checks above, then reload.
phoneCard.step1: Install the Tailscale app on the phone and sign in to this branch's tailnet. An admin may need to approve the phone.
phoneCard.step2: Turn Tailscale on. It works on any network, not only the branch Wi-Fi.
phoneCard.step3: Open the phone's Camera app, point it at this code, and tap the link.
ready.title: Ready for phones?
ready.failed: Could not check. Reload the page and try again.
scan.title: Scan Parcel
scan.lead: Scan the barcode with the camera or a barcode scanner, or type the tracking code and press Enter.
scan.relatedNone: No other parcels on this phone number.
scan.related: {count, plural, one {# more parcel on this phone number.} other {# more parcels on this phone number.}}
scan.loadFailed: The parcel list could not be loaded, so this code cannot be looked up. {error}
scan.cameraRead: The camera read this code from the label. If it does not match the printed tracking code, scan again or type it.
scan.checkLabel: Check the code against the label.
scan.notImported: If the parcel arrived today, its file may not be imported yet.
camera.unsupported.title: This browser cannot use the camera
camera.unsupported.help: Try the latest Chrome or Safari, or type the tracking code instead.
camera.denied.title: Camera access is blocked
camera.denied.help: Allow the camera for this site in the browser’s site settings (on iPhone: Settings › Safari › Camera), then try again. You can also type the code.
camera.noCamera.title: No camera found
camera.noCamera.help: This device has no camera the browser can use. Type the tracking code instead.
camera.busy.title: The camera is busy
camera.busy.help: Another app or tab is using it. Close that, then try again.
camera.paused.title: Camera paused
camera.paused.help: The camera stops while the page is in the background.
camera.failed.title: The camera could not start
camera.failed.help: Try again, or type the tracking code instead.
camera.title: Scan with camera
camera.lead: Point the camera at the barcode on the parcel label.
camera.slow: Still can't read a barcode. Hold the label flat and steady about 10–20 cm away, in good light, with the whole barcode inside the box. If the label is damaged, close this and type the code.
camera.looking: Looking for a barcode. It is read automatically, no button needed.
folder.title: Watched folder
folder.lead: Where staff save the courier export. Scan Folder Now on Import Arrivals checks it; files found still wait for review and confirmation.
folder.hint: The full path as the branch computer sees it. The installer creates C:\Users\Public\Documents\Campus Branch Imports for this.
folder.autoOn: On: the folder is also checked on its own while the app runs.
folder.autoOff: Off: files are found only when someone uses Scan Folder Now.
folder.adminOnly: Only the admin account can change the watched folder.
folder.chooseLead: Folders on the branch computer. Open one, then use it.
backup.title: Backups and data
backup.lead: Backups are made automatically on this computer and kept for 7 days. They do not protect against losing the computer itself.
backup.loadFailed: Backup status could not be loaded. Reload the page.
backup.failing: Backups are failing. Tell the admin.
backup.saveFailed: The backup could not be saved. Try again, or tell the admin.
backup.deletedAfterDays: {count, plural, one {Customer data is deleted after # day.} other {Customer data is deleted after # days.}}
backup.adminOnly: Only the admin can change this.
backup.removed: Parcels, phone numbers and messages older than this are removed for good, and disappear from backups within 3 more days. Accounts and settings are kept.
backup.nextDeletion: {label} {parcels, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}} for {customers, plural, one {# customer} other {# customers}} that arrived on {date} or earlier {parcels, plural, one {is} other {are}} deleted, with their phone numbers and messages.
backup.nothingDue: Nothing is due for deletion after midnight.

settingsError.folderEmpty: Enter the folder the logistics system exports to.
settingsError.folderPath: Use the full path, for example D:\Logistics\Exports or \\server\exports.
settingsError.templateUnknown: {token} is not a placeholder. Use {name}, {codes}, {count}, {date} or {newline}.
settingsError.templateCodes: Include {codes} so the customer knows which parcels arrived.
settingsError.urlScheme: Use an http:// or https:// address.
settingsError.urlFull: Enter the full address, for example http://192.168.1.20:8080.
settingsError.gapOrder: The longest wait cannot be shorter than the shortest.
settingsError.column: Enter the column heading exactly as it appears in the export.
settings.title: System Settings
settings.lead: Folder monitoring, import rules and customer messages for this branch.
settings.adminOnly: Only the admin account can change these.
settings.always1: Rows whose tracking code is already in the branch records are skipped with a warning. The rest of the file still imports.
settings.always2: Saved phone numbers and notification history are kept. A different phone number in a new file does not overwrite them.
settings.import.title: Import preferences
settings.import.lead: How export files are read and what happens with repeats.
settings.import.trackingHint: Required. A file without it is not imported.
settings.import.phoneHint: Used to group parcels by customer.
settings.import.again: When the same file is imported again
settings.import.againHint: Recognised by the file's fingerprint, even if it was renamed.
settings.import.warnHelp: Shows which earlier import it matches before anything is saved.
settings.import.blockHelp: The file is refused. Staff can still upload a corrected export.
settings.sms.title: Default SMS message
settings.sms.lead: The app picks the version by how many new parcels a customer has. Staff can still edit each message before it is queued.
settings.sms.placeholders: Placeholders: {name} first name, {codes} tracking codes (required), {count} number of parcels, {date} arrival date (dd-mm-yyyy), {newline} a new line (or press Enter).
settings.sms.fixFirst: Fix the message to see a preview.
settings.gap.title: Gap between SMS
settings.gap.lead: The gateway phone waits a random time in this range between two SMS, so the branch SIM looks like a person sending, not a bulk sender.
settings.gap.estimate: 50 customers take about {from}–{to} minutes. Shorter waits send faster, but make it more likely that the carrier blocks the SIM.
dash.title: Today at Campus Branch
dash.lead: What needs you now. Each item opens the page where it gets done.
dash.qr.title: Open on a phone
dash.qr.lead: Scan with the phone's camera to open this console. The phone needs Tailscale turned on.
dash.qr.noAddress: No phone address yet. An admin can see why in Settings, under Set up a staff phone.

dash.caughtUpLead: No files to review, no messages to send or retry and no missing phone numbers.
dash.folder.title: Folder files to review
dash.folder.hint: Found in the watched folder. They are not imported until you review and confirm them.
dash.retry.hint: The gateway rejected these, or never confirmed delivery. Retry, or call instead.
dash.toMessage.hint: Arrived parcels nobody has told the customer about. One message covers every parcel on a phone that is not notified yet.
dash.noPhone.hint: The export had no usable number. Add one so the customer can be messaged; until then these are left out of messages.
dash.inFlight: {count} SMS waiting at the gateway. Those parcels are left out above so nobody gets the same message twice.
dash.importsFailed: The import history could not be loaded. {error}

gw.help.unreachable: Check that the phone is on, SMSGate shows “Stop service” on its Home tab, and Tailscale is connected on both.
gw.help.timeout: The phone may be asleep or on a weak connection. Check it, then check again.
gw.help.auth: Run npm run gateway -- set on the branch computer again, with the username and password the gateway app shows now.
gw.help.refused: Check the gateway app is SMSGate with Local Server turned on.
gw.title: SMS gateway
gw.lead: The Android phone with the branch SIMs sends every SMS. Its address and password are set on the branch computer, not here.
gw.loadFailed: The gateway status could not be loaded. Reload the page.
gw.setUp: Not set up. On the branch computer, run {command} and type the address, username and password from the gateway app (Settings › Local Server).
gw.d.notCharging: {level}% · not charging, keep it on the charger
gw.d.setAuto: . Set the phone to automatic time.
gw.d.deleted: Deleted on the phone after {count} days
gw.t.failedStatus: The test SMS could not be sent ({status}).
gw.t.noSim: {carrier}: no {carrier} SIM is set up, so nothing would be sent
gw.t.title: Test SMS
gw.t.phone: Phone number to send the test to
gw.t.adminOnly: Only an admin can send a test SMS.
gw.t.hint: Sends a short test message, naming the SIM it came from, to the number you type.
gw.t.fromSimTo: From SIM {sim} to a number ending {ending}, sent at {time}
gw.t.to: To a number ending {ending}, sent at {time}
gw.t.someCarriers: Some carriers never confirm delivery. If the phone got it, the test passed.
gw.s.failed: The SIMs could not be scanned ({status}).
gw.s.title: SIMs in the gateway phone
gw.s.lead: Each SMS goes from the SIM of its customer's carrier. Customers on a carrier with no confirmed SIM here are listed under Contact by hand on Notifications.
gw.s.problem: The phone could not be asked just now: {problem} The SIMs below are from the last scan.
gw.s.none: No SIMs found. Check that SMSGate is allowed the Phone permission on the gateway phone, then press Scan SIMs.
gw.c.choose: Choose the carrier of this SIM.
gw.c.until: Until it is confirmed, this SIM sends nothing and its carrier's customers are contacted by hand.
n.lead: Fix what went wrong, send today's messages in one go, and look back at what was sent.
n.att.title: Needs your attention
n.att.hint: Messages that failed or can't be confirmed, parcels with no number, and customers to chase.
n.att.clearLead: No failed or uncertain messages, and every parcel has a number.
n.att.noPhone: No phone number, left out of SMS
n.q.empty: Sending queue is empty. Start one with Notify today's customers.
n.q.title: Sending queue
n.q.hint: Handed to the gateway phone one at a time, {gap} apart so the SIM is not flagged. Accepted messages move to History; failed or unconfirmed ones move to Needs your attention.
n.q.waitingPhone: Waiting for the gateway phone: {done} of {total} handed over
n.q.simPause: Paused: SIM {sim} failed twice in a row. Check the gateway phone (a call on that SIM, no credit or no signal), then press Resume. The failed SMS are under Needs your attention.
n.q.noGateway: No gateway phone is set up, so nothing is being sent. The messages wait here. The administrator sets the phone up on the branch computer; see SMS gateway in Settings.
n.q.away: The gateway phone has not answered since {time}, so nothing is being sent. Check that it is switched on, the SMS Gateway app is running and it is on the network. The messages wait and go out when it answers.
n.miss.text: SIM {sim} is not in the gateway phone, so {count, plural, one {1 SMS for it is waiting. Put the SIM back, or contact this customer by hand instead.} other {# SMS for it are waiting. Put the SIM back, or contact these customers by hand instead.}}
n.restore.title: SMS sending is on hold after a restore
n.restore.lead: The data was restored from a copy taken {time}. Messages the gateway phone sent after that are not in this app, so those customers look not messaged yet. Nothing is sent until you check.
n.restore.step1: On the gateway phone, open the Messages app and look at what was sent since {time}.
n.restore.step2: Tick every customer below that the phone shows a message for. They are saved as Sent and not messaged again.
n.restore.none: No customer since the copy is waiting for a message.
n.restore.checked: I checked the gateway phone's sent messages since {time}.
n.restore.save: Save {count} as sent and resume sending
n.ready.title: Ready to notify
n.ready.parcels: {count, plural, one {# parcel from today, one SMS per phone number} other {# parcels from today, one SMS per phone number}}
n.ready.split: {auto} by SMS · {byHand} to contact by hand
n.ready.running: A run is in progress. Start the next one when it finishes.
n.ready.hold: Sending is on hold after a restore. Check the gateway phone first.
n.ready.noSim: No SIM in the gateway phone is confirmed yet, so every customer is to be contacted by hand. Confirm the SIMs in {link}.
n.ready.noGateway: No gateway phone is set up yet, so nothing can be sent. The administrator sets it up on the branch computer; see {link}.
n.ready.noPhoneSkipped: {count, plural, one {1 of today's parcels has no phone number and is skipped.} other {# of today's parcels have no phone number and are skipped.}}
n.ready.olderLead: Sent one day at a time after you review them, never with today's messages.
n.time.takes: Takes about {time}: the phone waits {gap} between messages, at random, so the branch SIM is not flagged.
n.day.summary: {sms} SMS · {count, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}}
n.confirm.title: Notify today's customers?
n.confirm.lead: The gateway phone sends them one at a time, each from the SIM of its customer's carrier.
n.confirm.summary: {count, plural, one {# parcel.} other {# parcels.}} {combined} combined, {individual} individual SMS. One SMS per phone number. Parcels already notified are left out.
n.confirm.byHandNote: {count, plural, one {1 customer is on a carrier with no confirmed SIM in the gateway phone. They are listed on the Contact by hand tab.} other {# customers are on a carrier with no confirmed SIM in the gateway phone. They are listed on the Contact by hand tab.}}
n.confirm.ownBatch: They go as their own batch and never join today's messages. Since then, some customers may have collected their parcel or been told another way. Read through the list below before sending.
n.confirm.checked: {count, plural, one {I checked this customer and they still need this message.} other {I checked these # customers and they still need this message.}}
n.confirm.noPhone: {count, plural, one {1 of today's parcels has no phone number and is skipped. They are listed under Needs your attention.} other {# of today's parcels have no phone number and are skipped. They are listed under Needs your attention.}}
n.confirm.messages: {count, plural, one {1 message to send} other {# messages to send}}
n.h.title: History
n.h.hint: Every SMS, call, Telegram message and SMS sent from a staff phone. A combined SMS is one entry.
n.h.search: Search history by phone, name or tracking code
n.h.tryWider: Try another search or a wider date range than {range}.
n.h.noneLead: Use Notify today's customers, or contact a customer from a scanned parcel.
n.r.title: Retry SMS to {phone}
n.r.mayHave: This message may already have reached the customer.
n.r.mayHaveLead: The gateway sent it but never confirmed delivery. A call or a Telegram check is safer than sending it again.
n.r.same: This sends the same message again as a new attempt (a new message if you edit it). The earlier attempt stays in the history.
n.r.reached: Staff already reached this customer another way, so this message may not be needed.
n.r.blocked: An SMS for these parcels is already waiting at the gateway. Wait for it before retrying.
n.bh.title: Contact by hand
